features.name: Sharpshooter
features.flavor: A master of ranged combat who trades accuracy for massive damage. Essential for archer builds and crossbow users.

effects.note: Ignore long and half cover and three-quarters cover when making a ranged attack, and your ranged weapon attacks ignore the 50/150 feet distance limits. When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can make an additional attack, using a ranged weapon, at a cost of 2 movement per 5 feet of distance travelled, and the attack has disadvantage. You also gain proficiency with the heavy crossbow and light crossbow.

features.summary: Ignore long and three-quarters cover; extra ranged attack at 2 speed/5 ft
features.text: Ignore long and half cover and three-quarters cover when making a ranged attack. Your ranged weapon attacks ignore the 50/150 feet distance limits. When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can make an additional attack, using a ranged weapon, at a cost of 2 movement per 5 feet of distance travelled.

features.name: Shield Master
features.flavor: A shield specialist who uses their shield to defend and bash enemies. Perfect for shield-wielding tanks.

effects.note: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can move as part of the attack, up to your speed, and you can move through a creature's space if its size is Medium or smaller. Whenever you take the Dodge action, you gain a +5 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, including after you use the Dodge action as a reaction. You also gain proficiency with shields.

features.summary: Move when attacking; +5 AC on Dodge, including as a reaction
features.text: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can move as part of the attack, up to your speed, and you can move through a creature's space if its size is Medium or smaller. Whenever you take the Dodge action, you gain a +5 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Charger
features.flavor: An aggressive combatant who uses movement to amplify their attacks. Great for barbarians, fighters, and mounted combatants.

effects.note: When you take the Dash action on your turn, you can use a bonus action to make one melee weapon attack, only if you move at least 20 feet toward the target, or at least 40 feet away from it. You have advantage on that attack roll and its damage rolls. You also have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks against creatures within 5 feet of you.

features.summary: Dash 20+ ft: bonus melee attack with advantage
features.text: When you take the Dash action on your turn, you can use a bonus action to make one melee weapon attack, only if you move at least 20 feet toward the target, or at least 40 feet away from it.

features.name: Weapon Master
features.flavor: A versatile martial character who gains proficiency with four weapons. Great for characters who use varied weapon types.

effects.note: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can use a bonus action to make one melee weapon attack, only if you have no attack yet this turn, and you use Strength for the attack. You must use a weapon you are proficient with, and the attack is at a disadvantage if you moved more than 10 feet.

features.summary: Bonus melee attack using Strength, at disadvantage if you moved
features.text: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can use a bonus action to make one melee weapon attack, only if you have no attack yet this turn, and you use Strength for the attack.

features.name: Blade Master

effects.note: You have learned to reattribute your finesse weapon's damage roll, and to hedge against a missed attack. Your critical hit dice for the attack increase by 1d8, and at 7th, 14th and 17th level you gain the ability to add 1d6 to the attack roll, 1d6 to the damage roll, or reroll a 1 or 2 on a damage die and use either roll.

features.summary: Finesse weapon crits gain 1d8; +1d6 to rolls at 7 and 14
features.text: Your critical hit dice for the attack increase by 1d8. At 7th level, you can add 1d6 to an attack roll that misses, and at 14th level you can add 1d6 to a damage roll.

source.reference: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes Blade Master

features.name: Critter
features.flavor: A small but fierce combatant who uses size to their advantage. Good for tiny races who want to contribute in combat.

effects.note: You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Survival) checks to perceive or track a creature, and on Charisma checks when interacting with a beast, a creature with the Beast type, or a magical creature whose type would be Beast.

features.summary: Advantage on perception and survival checks about creatures
features.text: You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Survival) checks to perceive or track a creature, and on Charisma checks when interacting with a beast.

features.name: Dungeon Delver
features.flavor: A seasoned explorer who excels at navigating dangerous ruins and avoiding traps. Perfect for rogues and dungeon-crawling specialists.

effects.note: Your maximum hit points are increased by your Intelligence modifier, and you have advantage on Intelligence (History) checks, and proficiency with thieves' tools. The bonuses increase by 1 at 6th, 12th and 17th level.

features.summary: Int to hit points, +1 to History, thieves' tools
features.text: Your maximum hit points are increased by your Intelligence modifier, and you have advantage on Intelligence (History) checks.

source.reference: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes Dungeon Delver

features.name: Elven Accuracy
features.flavor: An elf, half-elf, or similar race with supernatural precision, granting triple advantage on attacks. Essential for Sharpshooter builds.

effects.note: You have darkvision out to 60 feet. You also gain proficiency with light crossbows and longbows and their ammunition, and you ignore disadvantage on all Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, including those against visible hidden creatures. At 17th level, you can reroll a 1 or 2 on a d20 ability check.
At 17th level, you can reroll a 1 or 2 on a d20 ability check and use either roll.

features.summary: Darkvision, bows, and no sight-based disadvantage
features.text: You have darkvision out to 60 feet. You gain proficiency with light crossbows and longbows and their ammunition, and you ignore disadvantage on all Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

source.reference: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes Elven Accuracy

features.name: Orcish Fury
features.flavor: An orc or half-orc who channels their ferocity into devastating blows. Perfect for orc barbarians and fighters.

effects.note: When you become frightened, you can use your reaction to make one melee weapon attack against a creature of your choice. At 10th level, you gain temporary hit points equal to 1 plus your Charisma modifier plus your proficiency bonus, and they last until you finish a short rest. At 17th level, when you become frightened, you can also make your number of attacks equal to your level, instead of one.
You gain temporary hit points equal to 1 plus your Charisma modifier plus your proficiency bonus.
When you become frightened, you can also make your number of attacks equal to your level.

features.summary: When frightened, react with a melee attack
features.text: When you become frightened, you can use your reaction to make one melee weapon attack against a creature of your choice.

source.reference: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes Orcish Fury

features.name: Infernal Constitution
features.flavor: A tiefling with hellish resilience, gaining damage resistances. Perfect for tiefling tanks and durable spellcasters.

effects.note: You have resistance to cold damage and you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed. At 17th level, you gain a Fiendish Resilience: once per long rest, when you make a saving throw with disadvantage, you can choose to succeed instead.
You also have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and once per long rest, when you make a saving throw with disadvantage, you can choose to succeed instead.

features.summary: Cold resistance; advantage against charm; 17: succeed on a disadvantage save
features.text: You have resistance to cold damage and you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed.

source.reference: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes Infernal Constitution

features.name: Keen Mind
features.flavor: A sharp intellect with perfect recall and spatial awareness. Perfect for wizards, artificers, and skill-focused characters.

effects.note: You gain proficiency in a skill of your choice and know the detect thoughts spell, castable without a spell slot once per long rest, and 17th-level Wizard and Sorcerer spells are always prepared.

features.summary: One skill, plus detect thoughts and always-prepared high-level spells
features.text: You gain proficiency in a skill of your choice, and you know the detect thoughts spell.

source.reference: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes Keen Mind

features.name: Aberrant Dragonmark
features.flavor: A manifestation of dragonmarks on your skin, granting spellcasting tied to a dragonmark house. Requires an existing dragonmark.

effects.note: Your Constitution score is increased by 1. You learn the aberration cantrip, which you can cast at will, and you learn to cast two wizard spells of your choice that are cantrips, which you can cast at will. At 5th level, your Constitution increases by 1 again, and you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls.
Your Constitution score is increased by 1 again, and you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls.

features.summary: +1 Con, aberration cantrip at will, and two wizard cantrips at will
features.text: Your Constitution score is increased by 1. You learn to cast two wizard spells of your choice that are cantrips, which you can cast at will.

source.reference: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes Aberrant Dragonmark

features.name: Gift of the Chromatic Dragon
features.flavor: A champion of chromatic dragons, gaining breath weapon and damage resistance. Perfect for dragon-themed characters.

effects.note: Increase your Strength by 2. Gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while wearing no armor, and the ability to see in dim light and darkness out to 120 feet. You also gain resistance to one damage type of your choice, and can throw a rock with a range of 40, 120 and 160 feet.

features.summary: +2 Str; darkvision 120; +1 AC unarmored; one damage resistance
features.text: Increase your Strength by 2, and you can see in dim light and darkness out to 120 feet. You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while wearing no armor.

source.reference: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes Gift of the Chromatic Dragon

features.name: Gift of the Metallic Dragon
features.flavor: A champion of metallic dragons, gaining healing breath and damage resistance. Perfect for supportive martial characters.

effects.note: Increase your Constitution by 2. You gain a +1 bonus to AC while wearing armor, immunity to critical hits against you, and additional damage equal to 2 to critical hits you make, and you can replace one of your attacks with a breath attack.

features.summary: +2 Con; +1 AC in armor; crit immunity; +2 crit damage
features.text: Increase your Constitution by 2. You gain a +1 bonus to AC while wearing armor, and immunity to critical hits against you.

source.reference: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes Gift of the Metallic Dragon

features.name: Gift of the Dragon Champion
features.flavor: A hero blessed by all dragons, gaining draconic resilience and damage resistance. For dragon-themed tanks and spellcasters.

effects.note: You have a magic gift from a dragon. You gain a +2 bonus to AC and saving throws while not wearing armor, your damage rolls against creatures with a +2 bonus, and you gain 10 hit points. At 5th, 10th, and 15th level your hit points increase by 5 and your Strength or Dexterity increases by 1, and at 5th level you can cast the detect magic spell once per long rest without a slot.

tiers.summary: +5 HP and +1 Str or Dex; detect magic once per rest

features.summary: +2 AC unarmored, +2 damage, 10 extra hit points
features.text: You have a magic gift from a dragon. You gain a +2 bonus to AC and saving throws while not wearing armor, and your damage rolls against creatures have a +2 bonus.

source.reference: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes Gift of the Dragon Champion

features.name: Favored by the Gods
features.flavor: A mortal touched by divine favor, gaining luck and resilience. Great for divine casters and chosen heroes.

effects.note: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, and gain proficiency in a skill or tool of your choice. Choose a god and gain their Bolt Domain, Blessing, or Restoration property.

features.summary: +1 to an ability, one skill or tool, and a deity's benefit
features.text: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, and you gain proficiency in a skill or tool of your choice.

source.reference: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes Favored by the Gods

features.name: Divinely Favored
features.flavor: A chosen champion of a deity, empowered by divine favor. Great for divine casters and zealous warriors.

effects.note: This feat is tied to the divine and the fearsome. You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws, and you gain a +1 bonus to all attack rolls you make with weapons or spells, and a +1 bonus to one saving throw of your choice. At 5th, 10th and 15th level the bonuses increase by 1.

features.summary: +1 to AC, saves, and attacks, and to one chosen save
features.text: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws. You also gain a +1 bonus to all attack rolls you make with weapons or spells.

source.reference: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes Divinely Favored

features.name: Diplomat
features.flavor: A smooth negotiator who finds common ground with anyone. Excellent for party faces and social adventurers.

effects.note: You gain proficiency in the Insight, Persuasion and Relocation skills, and you gain the benefits of the innate magical trait of your choice: Mimicry, Photomemory or Read Thoughts.

features.summary: Three social skills plus an innate magical trait
features.text: You gain proficiency in Insight, Persuasion and Relocation.

features.name: Everybody's Friend
features.flavor: A naturally charismatic character who can befriend anyone. Great for bards, sorcerers, and social rogues.

effects.note: You gain proficiency in Sleight of Hand and Stealth, and you gain the benefits of the innate magical trait of your choice: Charm, Detect Thoughts, or Illusory Reality. At 5th level you gain a second of these traits.
You gain a second innate magical trait of your choice.

features.summary: Sleight of Hand and Stealth, plus an innate magical trait
features.text: You gain proficiency in Sleight of Hand and Stealth.

source.reference: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes Everybody's Friend
